title: Li-ion battery export unit-value index — world (published-table basis, USD)
licence: Single-series data: free to read and cite with attribution to WattAnalysis. Bulk download or programmatic redistribution requires a licence (API key).
unit: Index (2020Q2 = 100); quarterly unit value in USD/piece

caliber.grade_spec: Lithium-ion accumulators (HS 85076000; cells and packs combined, not further separable)

source_name: General Administration of Customs quantities and values (published-table TAB caliber)
release_boundary: Public as an index layer; every point carries its base period and the standing label "declared unit value, not a transaction price". External release was conditional on the FX-adjusted residual check (method note s.5); that check was completed on 2026-11-22 (QC #97) and all 31 paired USD/CNY points passed within ±2pp of the PBoC central-parity quarterly mean (see release_gate).
labels: WA-calculated declared unit value — not a transaction price

points.note: Quarterly unit value = total declared value / total declared quantity (3/3 months complete, trade-weighted); base 2020Q2 = 100; customs declared unit value (WA-CALC derived), not a market transaction price; external release pending the FX-adjusted residual check gate (method note §5)

Quarterly unit value = total declared value / total declared quantity (3/3 months complete, trade-weighted); base 2020Q2 = 100; customs declared unit value (WA-CALC derived), not a market transaction price; external release pending the FX-adjusted residual check gate (method note §5)
